title: An IT help desk for your staff
summary: Your people ask IT for help with a form in Taskiem; each request gets a number, goes to the right person and is answered to them.
description: Your staff sign in to Taskiem and fill in a short form: what they need help with and the details. Their name and email come from their sign-in, so nobody types them. Each request becomes a ticket with a number (T-1042) in your tickets table, the page shows its number, and the people who look after that kind of request (sign-ins and access, hardware, software, the network, or your own list) are told on WhatsApp, Telegram or by email. They answer with the Answer customers' tickets form; the member who asked hears the answer on WhatsApp, Telegram or by email, and the Follow up tickets workflow reminds IT of requests nobody has answered.

variables.name: ticket_reply_form
variables.why: The link of your ticket reply form (the Answer customers' tickets workflow), put in each message to a department so they can answer at once.

params.name: departments
params.title: Departments
params.description: One kind of request per line: its name, the role whose members answer it, what it looks after, and words that send a request there, separated by a | sign. Give each the role of your IT people (it, unless you use another).
params.example:
Accounts and access | it | Sign-ins, passwords, email accounts and who can open what | password, login, log in, sign in, locked, access, account, email
Hardware | it | Laptops, phones, printers and other equipment | laptop, computer, printer, phone, screen, keyboard, mouse, charger, battery
Software | it | Programs and apps: installing, updating and using them | install, app, software, program, update, licence, excel, word
Network | it | Internet, Wi-Fi and the office network | internet, wifi, wi-fi, network, connection, vpn, offline
Other | it | Anything else |
params.default:
Accounts and access | it | Sign-ins, passwords, email accounts and who can open what | password, login, log in, sign in, locked, access, account, email
Hardware | it | Laptops, phones, printers and other equipment | laptop, computer, printer, phone, screen, keyboard, mouse, charger, battery
Software | it | Programs and apps: installing, updating and using them | install, app, software, program, update, licence, excel, word
Network | it | Internet, Wi-Fi and the office network | internet, wifi, wi-fi, network, connection, vpn, offline
Other | it | Anything else |

params.name: default_department
params.title: Department when none fits
params.description: One of your kinds of request, by its name: it gets the requests that fit no other.

params.name: routing
params.title: How a ticket finds its department
params.description: ai: Taskiem's AI reads the request and picks its kind, how urgent it is and a one-line summary. rules (the default): the first kind with one of its words in the request. chosen: the kind the member picked.

params.name: acknowledgement
params.title: What the member is told first
params.description: The first answer a member gets when they ask; their request's number is added after it.
params.default: Thank you. IT has your request and will get back to you.
params.example: Thank you. IT has your request and will get back to you.

definition.name: IT help desk
